why: The two floors scripts/check-guidance.mjs refuses to let fall. Raised by hand in the same change that authors the entries, because a script that raised them automatically would lower them automatically. `authored` counts entries carrying the nine original fields; `advised` counts the ones that also carry the six L1b added, and it is a second number rather than a share of the first because every entry written before 2026-08-10 was authored against a contract that did not have them. Folding the two together would have reported the whole corpus as incomplete on the day the schema changed. The 100 family raises both, one pillar per row: 100b took data-and-ai-governance to 13 of 13 authored and all 13 advised (+8 and +13); 100c takes interoperability-and-usability to 15 of 15 authored and all 15 advised (+10 and +15); 100d takes reliability to 18 of 18 authored and all 18 advised (+6 and +17); 100e takes operational-excellence to 21 of 21 authored and all 21 advised (+9 and +21); 100f takes cost-optimization to 22 of 22 authored and all 22 advised (+15 and +21 — CO-01-03 already carried advice, so fifteen new entries and six extensions raise advised by twenty-one from the prior 68); 100g takes performance-efficiency to 25 of 25 authored and all 25 advised (+9 and +25 from the prior 111/89 — none of the sixteen existing PE entries carried advice); 100h takes security SCP-01 (identity and access) to 7 of 7 authored and all 7 advised (`SCP-01-01` and `SCP-01-02` were already authored, so +5 and +7 from the prior 120/114); 100i takes security SCP-02 (data in transit and at rest) to 12 of 12 authored and all 12 advised (+12 and +12 from the prior 125/121); 100j takes security SCP-03 (network and endpoints) to 13 of 13 authored and all 13 advised (`SCP-03-01`, `03-02` and `03-13` were already authored, so +10 and +13 from the prior 137/133); 100k takes security SCP-04 (compliance and data privacy) to 23 of 23 authored and all 23 advised (`SCP-04-06` was already authored, so +22 and +23 from the prior 147/146); 100l takes security SCP-05 (monitor system security) to 15 of 15 authored and all 15 advised (+15 and +15 from the prior 169/169), which finishes the pillar at 70 of 70.
why_this_used_to_record_a_question_count: It recorded `questions` as well, and a note explaining why the authored floor sat above it: the reach was the 52 attestation controls, and eleven entries were authored for requirements that later became measures and kept their guidance. From 38b the reach is every requirement, so both the number and the gap it explained are history. Kept as a sentence rather than deleted because the question it answers — why is the floor above the thing it is supposed to floor — is the one a reader asks when the two numbers disagree, and the answer is now that they are not being compared.
